name: NurExone Biologic Inc.
summary: NurExone Biologic Inc. is a pharmaceutical technology company developing a platform for exosome-based therapies, guided biologically, aimed at injuries of the central nervous system. Its lead product, ExoPTEN, has preclinical data that support potential use against acute injury of the spinal cord and optic nerve. Founded in 2011, it is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
